module: Flowgraph node "Pursuit Roadblock" (once_instant). Places up to 3 vehicles (vehId1..3) in a roadblock with gameplay_police.placeRoadblock. Inputs: pos, rot, width, angle, centerAngle, checkWidth (declared but not passed on in the code).
notes: The checkWidth pin is declared but never read by workOnce.
pos and rot are converted without a nil check.

workOnce.desc: Gathers the vehicle ids, builds the parameters {angle, centerAngle, width} and calls gameplay_police.placeRoadblock.
